3277-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
3277-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4687-5479-6723.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least three charge counters on it.
4687-5479-6723.description:
Activate A Realm Reborn by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte two times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping two lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

628-5490-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

553-2093-5049.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Leyline of Anticipation.
In response, cast Lapse of Certainty by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

2-2034-5554-7824.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

511-817-1887-4050-7824.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

413-789-1263-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Gutter Grime and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

3249-5111-5173-6797.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

2034-2591-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Redcap Gutter-Dweller.
When Redcap Gutter-Dweller enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more counters on it

2713-4050-5523-7218.description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Zirda and removing two counters from it, returning Defiant Greatmaw from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

1846-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
1846-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

628-6797-7214.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1115-1563-3899-4365.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3459-4474-5078-5741.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5413-6754.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-6754.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1651-2499-3875-4426-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-3875-4426-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-3875-4426-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

997-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
997-5571-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1036-2060-2919-4222.description:
Activate Wellwisher by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Wellwisher.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

3525-3609-6702.easyPrerequisites: You have a repeatable way to allow Kilo to tap.
3525-3609-6702.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time. Then, repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
3525-3609-6702.notes: You can use any method(s) to tap Kilo three times per turn. If those methods have additional costs (such as life payments, mana, etc.), then you must pay those costs three times as well.

2164-3587-5872.easyPrerequisites: You have another card in hand.
2164-3587-5872.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Boros Reckoner indestructible.
2164-3587-5872.description:
Give Boros Reckoner indestructible, if needed.
Cast Chain of Plasma by paying {1}{R}, dealing 3 damage to Boros Reckoner and causing you to discard a card and copy Chain of Plasma targeting Boros Reckoner.
Taii Wakeen and Boros Reckoner trigger.
Resolve the Taii Wakeen trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Boros Reckoner trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Chain of Plasma copy, dealing 3 damage to Boros Reckoner and causing you to discard a card and copy Chain of Plasma targeting Boros Reckoner.
Repeat from step 3.

2131-2541-3595.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Shambling Shell from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing you to discard Shambling Shell.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

575-1184-2482-3470.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Kin-Tree Warden.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Kin-Tree Warden enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

222-527-2079-2921.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2079-2921.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

394-4798-5636-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-4798-5636-5686.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, putting a +1/+1 counter on Psychic Frog.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat.

1046-1479-4288.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
1046-1479-4288.description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a tapped Powerstone artifact token.
When the Powerstone token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1253-2713-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Gyre Engineer.
Gyre Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
1253-2713-2816.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Gyre Engineer by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1215-2034-4044-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hope of Ghirapur, adding {C}{C}.
When Hope of Ghirapur dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Hope of Ghirapur on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hope of Ghirapur from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

215-251-546.notablePrerequisites: Ramos and Denry Klin have at least five +1/+1 counters on them.
215-251-546.description:
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Ramos to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Ramos by paying {6}, causing it to enter the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters on it due to Denry Klin.
Repeat.

1267-3395-3745.notablePrerequisites:
Identity Thief does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill Identity Thief.
1267-3395-3745.description:
Declare Identity Thief as an attacker.
Identity Thief triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless, becoming a copy of it until end of turn and Return Medomai from exile to the battlefield at end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Identity Thief, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Identity Thief from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Identity Thief by paying {2}{U}{U}.
At the beginning of your end step, Identity Thief triggers, returning Medomai from exile to the battlefield.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
